description.value: Banana Leaf is Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, established in 1995 and now spanning five Metro Vancouver locations, with this outpost on busy Robson Street. The menu draws on Malaysian, Indonesian, Singaporean, Thai, Chinese, and Indian influences across more than 40 dishes, from Roti Canai and Beef Rendang to fresh seafood preparations. Takeout and delivery are available alongside full dine-in service, making it a practical mid-ride meal stop in the West End.
